text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 502/504 error rate observed at API gateway (edge-proxy) starting ~1718245380. See runbook: /runbooks/gateway-5xx. Paging oncall.
Ryan (oncall): acked. I’m on it — pulling up dashboards now.
Maria (prod-observability): showing a sharp jump in 5xx fraction for gateway between 11:23-11:27 UTC. 5xx% peaked ~11.8% across edge cluster, p95 latency for gateway up from 85ms -> 420ms.
Ryan (oncall): quick query from Prometheus:
```
# 5xx rate at gateway
sum(rate(http_responses_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[1m]))
```
result: ~0.118 at peak.
Ryan (oncall): tailing gateway logs shows repeated upstream timeouts (504) and some 502 from edge->origin LB.
Cheng: I can take lead on mitigation — oncall handoff: Ryan handing to Cheng now. Ryan, please paste any relevant traces.
Ryan (oncall): handing off. Recent deploy? nothing obvious in service deploys around 11:20. But there was a config push to the edge LB at ~11:18 (healthcheck changes). Logs:
```
[2024-04-12T11:22:59Z] gateway edge-proxy: upstream timeout to origin-pool-3 (read timeout)
[repeat x 120]
```
ops-sre: can you try increasing upstream timeout and scaling up edge-proxy replicas? Also check connection pool exhaustion on origin.
Cheng: applying two mitigations now:
1) bump gateway upstream read_timeout from 5s -> 10s
2) scale edge-proxy replicas +2 in us-west-2
Commands:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/edge-proxy UPSTREAM_READ_TIMEOUT=10
kubectl -n infra scale deploy edge-proxy --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy edge-proxy -o=jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+2))
```
Hailey (support): rough customer impact? support tickets are spiking for API timeouts; ~18 customers reported errors in last 20m, some time-sensitive webhooks failing.
Maria (prod-observability): after the timeout bump + scale at 11:31, 5xx% dropped to 2.1% by 11:37, then stabilized near baseline (~0.6%) by 11:46.
SRE Lead: good quick mitigation. Did we confirm root cause? config push to LB at 11:18 seems suspicious. Any backlog on origin causing connection queueing?
Cheng: preliminary logs from origin-pool-3 show SYN backlog and connection resets from upstream health probes. I'm going to temporarily remove origin-pool-3 from the loadset and monitor.
Commands:
```
# remove pool
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/loadbalancer/pools/origin-pool-3/remove" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
incident-bot: Status page updated: partial outage (degraded) for API gateway. Incident channel created.
Ryan (oncall): removed origin-pool-3 at 11:34; error rate dropped further. It looks like origin-pool-3 had a bad JVM GC pause or networking blip that caused cascading upstream timeouts.
Cheng: rebalanced traffic and enabled aggressive circuit-break for origin pools to prevent repeat.
ops-sre: recommended follow-ups: revert the LB healthcheck change that was pushed at 11:18, add a connection pool metric alert, and run a controlled load test against origin-pool-3 to reproduce.
Hailey (support): support updated customers that we mitigated and are investigating; posting to status page now.
SRE Lead: Handoff closed. We'll run a full postmortem. Owners: Cheng (mitigation + root cause), Maria (metrics + dashboards), ops-sre (LB healthchecks), Ryan (incident write-up). ETA for postmortem draft: 48h.
Cheng: marking incident resolved for now; keeping watch for 2h. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
